def RSFResult (α : Type) := Except RSFError α

def RSFResult.bind {α β : Type} (x : RSFResult α) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult β :=
  match x with
  | Except.ok v => f v
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def RSFResult.map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (x : RSFResult α) : RSFResult β :=
  match x with
  | Except.ok v => Except.ok (f v)
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

theorem RSFResult.bind_ok {α β : Type} (v : α) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult.bind (Except.ok v) f = f v := rfl

theorem RSFResult.bind_error {α β : Type} (e : RSFError) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult.bind (Except.error e) f = Except.error e := rfl

theorem RSFResult.map_ok {α β : Type} (v : α) (f : α → β) : RSFResult.map f (Except.ok v) = Except.ok (f v) := rfl

theorem RSFResult.map_error {α β : Type} (e : RSFError) (f : α → β) : RSFResult.map f (Except.error e) = Except.error e := rfl

def Bool.and_true_eq (b : Bool) : b && true = b :=

def maxUsize : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def maxU64 : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def listLength {α : Type} : List α → Nat
| [] => 0
| _ :: as => 1 + listLength as

structure Tensor (N : Type) where
  shape : Shape
  data : List N
  storage_id : Nat
  offset : Nat

def tensorsOverlap {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq a.storage_id b.storage_id with
  | isFalse _ => false
  | isTrue _ =>
    let a_end := a.offset + a.data.length
    let b_end := b.offset + b.data.length
    match Nat.decLt a.offset b_end with
    | isFalse _ => false
    | isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decLt b.offset a_end with
      | isFalse _ => false
      | isTrue _ => true

def sameTensorStorage {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq a.storage_id b.storage_id with
  | isTrue _ => true
  | isFalse _ => false

def checkedMul (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxUsize with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok (a * b)
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

theorem checkedMul_success (a b : Nat) (h : a * b ≤ maxUsize) : checkedMul a b = Except.ok (a * b) :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxUsize with
  | isTrue _ => rfl
  | isFalse hf => False.elim (hf h)

theorem checkedMul_fail (a b : Nat) (h : ¬ (a * b ≤ maxUsize)) : checkedMul a b = Except.error RSFError.Overflow :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxUsize with
  | isTrue ht => False.elim (h ht)
  | isFalse _ => rfl

def checkedMulU64 (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxU64 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok (a * b)
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

def checkedAddU64 (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe (a + b) maxU64 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok (a + b)
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

def checkedCastU64ToUsize (v : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe v maxUsize with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok v
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.TooLarge

structure NumericSemantics (N : Type) where
  zero : N
  one : N
  add : N → N → N
  sub : N → N → N
  mul : N → N → N
  div : N → N → N
  exp : N → N
  clip : N → N → N → N
  finite : N → Bool
  f16_convertible : N → Bool
  tol_cmp : N → N → N → N → Bool
  deriv_gate : N → N → N → N
  eq : N → N → Bool
  lt : N → N → Bool
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b, sub (add a b) b = a
  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b, div (mul a b) b = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a b, mul (div a b) b = a
  clip_min : ∀ v cmin cmax, (finite v → finite cmin → finite cmax → lt cmin cmax → finite (clip v cmin cmax))
  clip_correct : ∀ v cmin cmax, (finite v → finite cmin → finite cmax → lt cmin cmax →
    (lt v cmin → clip v cmin cmax = cmin) ∧
    (lt cmax v → clip v cmin cmax = cmax) ∧
    ((¬ lt v cmin) → (¬ lt cmax v) → clip v cmin cmax = v))
  exp_pos : ∀ v, finite v → finite (exp v) ∧ ¬ eq (exp v) zero
  deriv_gate_spec : ∀ p cmin cmax, (finite p → finite cmin → finite cmax → lt cmin cmax →
    (lt p cmin → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) zero) ∧
    (lt cmax p → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) zero) ∧
    ((¬ lt p cmin) → (¬ lt cmax p) → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) one))

def validateClipRange {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match sem.finite cmin, sem.finite cmax with
  | true, true =>
    match sem.lt cmin cmax with
    | true => Except.ok ()
    | false => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite

def validateComparisonTolerances {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (abs_tol rel_tol : N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match sem.finite abs_tol, sem.finite rel_tol with
  | true, true => Except.ok ()
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidTolerance

def validateTensor2D {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match checkedMul d0 d1 with
    | Except.ok expected =>
      match Nat.decEq t.data.length expected with
      | isTrue _ => Except.ok ()
      | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

def validateTensor2DShape {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (rows cols : Nat) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.decEq d0 rows, Nat.decEq d1 cols with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ =>
      match checkedMul rows cols with
      | Except.ok expected =>
        match Nat.decEq t.data.length expected with
        | isTrue _ => Except.ok ()
        | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch
  | _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

def tensorHasShape {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (rows cols : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.decEq d0 rows, Nat.decEq d1 cols with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ => true
    | _, _ => false
  | _ => false

def tensorsSameShape {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match a.shape.dims, b.shape.dims with
  | a0 :: a1 :: [], b0 :: b1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.decEq a0 b0, Nat.decEq a1 b1 with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ => true
    | _, _ => false
  | _, _ => false

def ensureFiniteSlice {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → RSFResult Unit
| [] => Except.ok ()
| x :: xs =>
  match sem.finite x with
  | true => ensureFiniteSlice sem xs
  | false => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite

structure RSFConfig (N : Type) where
  clip_min : N
  clip_max : N
  grad_mean : Bool
  max_dim : Nat
  max_layers : Nat

def validateModelConfigValues {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim num_layers : Nat) (cfg : RSFConfig N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match Nat.decEq dim 0 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  | isFalse _ =>
    match Nat.decEq num_layers 0 with
    | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
    | isFalse _ =>
      match validateClipRange sem cfg.clip_min cfg.clip_max with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok _ =>
        match Nat.decEq cfg.max_dim 0 with
        | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
        | isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decEq cfg.max_layers 0 with
          | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
          | isFalse _ =>
            match Nat.decLe dim cfg.max_dim with
            | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
            | isTrue _ =>
              match Nat.decLe num_layers cfg.max_layers with
              | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
              | isTrue _ => Except.ok ()

def validateF16Convertible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → RSFResult Unit
| [] => Except.ok ()
| x :: xs =>
  match sem.finite x, sem.f16_convertible x with
  | true, true => validateF16Convertible sem xs
  | false, _ => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite
  | _, false => Except.error RSFError.NumericFailure

def zeroTensor {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (t : Tensor N) : Tensor N :=
  { t with data := t.data.map (fun _ => sem.zero) }

def tensorClone {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (new_id : Nat) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D t with
  | Except.ok _ => Except.ok { t with storage_id := new_id, offset := 0 }
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def copyTensorPairInto {N : Type} (in1 in2 out1 out2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsSameShape in1 out1, tensorsSameShape in2 out2 with
  | true, true =>
    match Nat.decEq in1.data.length out1.data.length, Nat.decEq in2.data.length out2.data.length with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ =>
      match tensorsOverlap out1 out2 with
      | false => Except.ok ({ out1 with data := in1.data }, { out2 with data := in2.data })
      | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
    | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

structure LayerCore (N : Type) where
  s_weight : Tensor N
  t_weight : Tensor N
  s_bias : Tensor N
  t_bias : Tensor N
  s_weight_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  t_weight_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  s_bias_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  t_bias_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  dim : Nat
  clip_min : N
  clip_max : N
  grad_mean : Bool

def initOwned {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (gmean : Bool) : RSFResult (LayerCore N) :=
  match Nat.decEq dim 0 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  | isFalse _ =>
    match validateClipRange sem cmin cmax with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok _ =>
      match checkedMul dim dim with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok _ =>
        Except.ok {
          s_weight := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 1, offset := 0 }
          t_weight := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 2, offset := 0 }
          s_bias := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 3, offset := 0 }
          t_bias := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 4, offset := 0 }
          s_weight_grad := none
          t_weight_grad := none
          s_bias_grad := none
          t_bias_grad := none
          dim := dim
          clip_min := cmin
          clip_max := cmax
          grad_mean := gmean
        }

def deinitOwned {N : Type} (layer : LayerCore N) : LayerCore N :=
  { layer with
    s_weight_grad := none
    t_weight_grad := none
    s_bias_grad := none
    t_bias_grad := none }

def ensureGradients {N : Type} (layer : LayerCore N) : LayerCore N :=
  let swg := match layer.s_weight_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [layer.dim, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 5, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  let twg := match layer.t_weight_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [layer.dim, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 6, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  let sbg := match layer.s_bias_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [1, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 7, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  let tbg := match layer.t_bias_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [1, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 8, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  { layer with s_weight_grad := swg, t_weight_grad := twg, s_bias_grad := sbg, t_bias_grad := tbg }

def zeroGradients {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) : LayerCore N :=
  let swg := match layer.s_weight_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  let twg := match layer.t_weight_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  let sbg := match layer.s_bias_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  let tbg := match layer.t_bias_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  { layer with s_weight_grad := swg, t_weight_grad := twg, s_bias_grad := sbg, t_bias_grad := tbg }

def elementwiseAdd {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.add a b :: elementwiseAdd sem as bs

def elementwiseSub {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.sub a b :: elementwiseSub sem as bs

def elementwiseMul {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.mul a b :: elementwiseMul sem as bs

def elementwiseDiv {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.div a b :: elementwiseDiv sem as bs

def dotProduct {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → N
| [], _ => sem.zero
| _, [] => sem.zero
| a::as, b::bs => sem.add (sem.mul a b) (dotProduct sem as bs)

def computeTranslationRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (tw tb input_row : List N) : List N :=
  List.zipWith (fun w b => sem.add (dotProduct sem w input_row) b) tw tb

def computeScaleRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw sb input_row : List N) : List N :=
  let preact := List.zipWith (fun w b => sem.add (dotProduct sem w input_row) b) sw sb
  let clipped := preact.map (fun v => sem.clip v cmin cmax)
  clipped.map sem.exp

def forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N) : List N × List N :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  (y1, y2)

def inverseRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb y1 y2 : List N) : List N × List N :=
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let x2 := elementwiseSub sem y2 trans
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let x1 := elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale
  (x1, x2)

theorem elementwiseSub_add_cancel {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : ∀ (a b : List N), a.length = b.length → elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem a b) b = a
| [], [], _ => rfl
| a::as, b::bs, h =>
  let h_len : as.length = bs.length := Nat.succ.inj h
  congr (congrArg List.cons (sem.sub_add_cancel a b)) (elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem as bs h_len)
| [], b::bs, h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)
| a::as, [], h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)

theorem elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : ∀ (a b : List N), a.length = b.length → elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem a b) b = a
| [], [], _ => rfl
| a::as, b::bs, h =>
  let h_len : as.length = bs.length := Nat.succ.inj h
  congr (congrArg List.cons (sem.div_mul_cancel a b)) (elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel sem as bs h_len)
| [], b::bs, h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)
| a::as, [], h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)

theorem pair_eq {α β : Type} {a c : α} {b d : β} (h1 : a = c) (h2 : b = d) : (a, b) = (c, d) :=
  congr (congrArg Prod.mk h1) h2

theorem inverseRow_forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N)
  (h_len1 : x1.length = (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2).length)
  (h_len2 : x2.length = (computeTranslationRow sem tw tb (elementwiseMul sem x1 (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2))).length) :
  inverseRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb (forwardRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).1 (forwardRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).2 = (x1, x2) :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  let h_x2 : elementwiseSub sem y2 trans = x2 := elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem x2 trans h_len2
  let h_scale : computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans) = scale := congrArg (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb) h_x2
  let h_x1 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans)) = x1 :=
    Eq.trans (congrArg (elementwiseDiv sem y1) h_scale) (elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel sem x1 scale h_len1)
  pair_eq h_x1 h_x2

def splitInto {N : Type} : Nat → List N → List N × List N
| 0, xs => ([], xs)
| Nat.succ n, [] => ([], [])
| Nat.succ n, x::xs =>
  let (l1, l2) := splitInto n xs
  (x::l1, l2)

def mergeFrom {N : Type} : List N → List N → List N
| [], ys => ys
| x::xs, ys => x :: mergeFrom xs ys

theorem merge_split_roundtrip {N : Type} : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : List N), mergeFrom (splitInto n x).1 (splitInto n x).2 = x
| 0, xs => rfl
| Nat.succ n, [] => rfl
| Nat.succ n, x::xs => congrArg (List.cons x) (merge_split_roundtrip n xs)

def processBatchForward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) : List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [] => ([], [])
| x1, x2 =>
  let (x1_row, x1_rest) := splitInto dim x1
  let (x2_row, x2_rest) := splitInto dim x2
  let (y1_row, y2_row) := forwardRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1_row x2_row
  let (y1_rest, y2_rest) := processBatchForward sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1_rest x2_rest
  (mergeFrom y1_row y1_rest, mergeFrom y2_row y2_rest)

def processBatchInverse {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) : List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [] => ([], [])
| y1, y2 =>
  let (y1_row, y1_rest) := splitInto dim y1
  let (y2_row, y2_rest) := splitInto dim y2
  let (x1_row, x2_row) := inverseRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_row y2_row
  let (x1_rest, x2_rest) := processBatchInverse sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_rest y2_rest
  (mergeFrom x1_row x1_rest, mergeFrom x2_row x2_rest)

def forwardInPlace {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (x1 x2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsOverlap x1 x2 with
  | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
  | false =>
    let (y1_data, y2_data) := processBatchForward sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data x1.data x2.data
    Except.ok ({ x1 with data := y1_data }, { x2 with data := y2_data })

def inverseInPlace {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsOverlap y1 y2 with
  | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
  | false =>
    let (x1_data, x2_data) := processBatchInverse sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data y1.data y2.data
    Except.ok ({ y1 with data := x1_data }, { y2 with data := x2_data })

def forwardChecked {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (x1 x2 out1 out2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match copyTensorPairInto x1 x2 out1 out2 with
  | Except.ok (o1, o2) => forwardInPlace sem layer o1 o2
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def inverseChecked {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 out1 out2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match copyTensorPairInto y1 y2 out1 out2 with
  | Except.ok (o1, o2) => inverseInPlace sem layer o1 o2
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def computeDsRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) : List N → List N → List N → List N
| [], _, _ => []
| _, [], _ => []
| _, _, [] => []
| p::ps, d::ds, y::ys => sem.mul (sem.deriv_gate p cmin cmax) (sem.mul d y) :: computeDsRow sem cmin cmax ps ds ys

def backwardFromOutputsRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : List N) (grad_scale : N) : List N × List N × List N × List N :=
  let dy1_total := elementwiseAdd sem dy1 (computeTranslationRow sem tw tb dy2)
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let x2_out := elementwiseSub sem y2 trans
  let preact := elementwiseAdd sem sb x2_out
  let clipped := preact.map (fun v => sem.clip v cmin cmax)
  let scale := clipped.map sem.exp
  let x1_out := elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale
  let dx1_out := elementwiseMul sem dy1_total scale
  let ds := computeDsRow sem cmin cmax preact dy1_total y1
  let dx2_out := elementwiseAdd sem dy2 (computeTranslationRow sem sw sb ds)
  (dx1_out, dx2_out, ds, dy1_total)

def processBatchBackward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) (grad_scale : N) : List N → List N → List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [], [], [] => ([], [])
| y1, y2, dy1, dy2 =>
  let (y1_row, y1_rest) := splitInto dim y1
  let (y2_row, y2_rest) := splitInto dim y2
  let (dy1_row, dy1_rest) := splitInto dim dy1
  let (dy2_row, dy2_rest) := splitInto dim dy2
  let (dx1_row, dx2_row, _, _) := backwardFromOutputsRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_row y2_row dy1_row dy2_row grad_scale
  let (dx1_rest, dx2_rest) := processBatchBackward sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb grad_scale y1_rest y2_rest dy1_rest dy2_rest
  (mergeFrom dx1_row dx1_rest, mergeFrom dx2_row dx2_rest)

def backwardFromOutputs {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Tensor N) (grad_scale : N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  let (dx1_data, dx2_data) := processBatchBackward sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data grad_scale y1.data y2.data dy1.data dy2.data
  Except.ok ({ y1 with data := dx1_data }, { y2 with data := dx2_data })

structure RegistryEntry (Core : Type) where
  core : Core
  active_ops : Nat
  destroyed : Bool

structure Registry (Core : Type) where
  entries : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)
  next_id : Nat

def registerRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (core : Core) : Registry Core × Nat :=
  let id := reg.next_id
  let new_entry := { core := core, active_ops := 0, destroyed := false : RegistryEntry Core }
  ({ entries := (id, new_entry) :: reg.entries, next_id := id + 1 }, id)

def lookupEntry {Core : Type} : Nat → List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) → Option (RegistryEntry Core)
| _, [] => none
| k, (k', v) :: rest =>
  match Nat.decEq k k' with
  | isTrue _ => some v
  | isFalse _ => lookupEntry k rest

def acquireRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : RSFResult Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    match lookupEntry id reg.entries with
    | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
    | some entry =>
      match entry.destroyed with
      | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
      | false => Except.ok entry.core

theorem acquire_zero_fails {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) : acquireRegistryCore reg 0 = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized := rfl

theorem acquire_destroyed_fails {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) (entry : RegistryEntry Core)
  (h_id : id ≠ 0) (h_lookup : lookupEntry id reg.entries = some entry) (h_dest : entry.destroyed = true) :
  acquireRegistryCore reg id = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized :=
  match id with
  | 0 => False.elim (h_id rfl)
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    Eq.subst (motive := fun x => (match x with | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | some e => match e.destroyed with | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | false => Except.ok e.core) = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized) h_lookup (
      Eq.subst (motive := fun x => (match x with | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | false => Except.ok entry.core) = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized) h_dest rfl
    )

structure RSFCore (N : Type) where
  dim : Nat
  num_layers : Nat
  layers : List (LayerCore N)
  cfg : RSFConfig N
  gpu_available : Bool
  gpu_weight_version : Nat
  cpu_weight_version : Nat

def checkedModelLayerCount {N : Type} (core : RSFCore N) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decEq core.num_layers core.layers.length with
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidModelState
  | isTrue _ =>
    match Nat.decEq core.layers.length 0 with
    | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
    | isFalse _ => Except.ok core.layers.length

def applyLayersForward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) : List (LayerCore N) → List N → List N
| [], x => x
| layer :: rest, x =>
  let (x1, x2) := splitInto dim x
  let (y1, y2) := forwardRow sem cmin cmax layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data x1 x2
  let y := mergeFrom y1 y2
  applyLayersForward sem dim cmin cmax rest y

def applyLayersInverse {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) : List (LayerCore N) → List N → List N
| [], y => y
| layer :: rest, y =>
  let y_prev := applyLayersInverse sem dim cmin cmax rest y
  let (y1, y2) := splitInto dim y_prev
  let (x1, x2) := inverseRow sem cmin cmax layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data y1 y2
  mergeFrom x1 x2

def forwardOnCore {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D x with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok dim2 =>
      let y_data := applyLayersForward sem core.dim core.cfg.clip_min core.cfg.clip_max core.layers x.data
      Except.ok { x with data := y_data }

def inverseOnCore {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (y : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D y with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok dim2 =>
      let x_data := applyLayersInverse sem core.dim core.cfg.clip_min core.cfg.clip_max core.layers y.data
      Except.ok { y with data := x_data }

theorem forwardOnCore_preserves_shape {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) :
  match forwardOnCore sem core x with
  | Except.ok y => y.shape = x.shape
  | Except.error _ => True :=
  match h_val : validateTensor2D x with
  | Except.error _ => trivial
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match h_mul : checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error _ => trivial
    | Except.ok _ => rfl

def layerGPUCompatible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (cfg : RSFConfig N) (dim : Nat) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq layer.dim dim with
  | isFalse _ => false
  | isTrue _ =>
    match sem.eq layer.clip_min cfg.clip_min with
    | false => false
    | true =>
      match sem.eq layer.clip_max cfg.clip_max with
      | false => false
      | true =>
        match layer.grad_mean == cfg.grad_mean with
        | false => false
        | true => true

theorem layerGPUCompatible_rejects_dim_mismatch {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (cfg : RSFConfig N) (dim : Nat)
  (h : layer.dim ≠ dim) : layerGPUCompatible sem layer cfg dim = false :=
  match Nat.decEq layer.dim dim with
  | isFalse _ => rfl
  | isTrue heq => False.elim (h heq)

def modelGPUCompatible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq core.layers.length 0 with
  | isTrue _ => false
  | isFalse _ => true

def tryForwardGPU {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) : Bool × Tensor N :=
  match core.gpu_available with
  | false => (false, x)
  | true =>
    match modelGPUCompatible sem core with
    | false => (false, x)
    | true =>
      match forwardOnCore sem core x with
      | Except.ok y => (true, y)
      | Except.error _ => (false, x)

theorem gpu_fallback_equals_cpu {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) :
  match tryForwardGPU sem core x with
  | (true, y) => forwardOnCore sem core x = Except.ok y
  | (false, _) => True :=
  match core.gpu_available with
  | false => trivial
  | true =>
    match modelGPUCompatible sem core with
    | false => trivial
    | true =>
      match h : forwardOnCore sem core x with
      | Except.ok _ => rfl
      | Except.error _ => trivial

def crc_step_byte_loop : Nat → Nat → Nat
| 0, c => c

  match Nat.decEq (c % 2) 1 with

def RSFResult (α : Type) := Except RSFError α

def RSFResult.bind {α β : Type} (x : RSFResult α) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult β :=
  match x with
  | Except.ok v => f v
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def RSFResult.map {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (x : RSFResult α) : RSFResult β :=
  match x with
  | Except.ok v => Except.ok (f v)
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

theorem RSFResult.bind_ok {α β : Type} (v : α) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult.bind (Except.ok v) f = f v := rfl

theorem RSFResult.bind_error {α β : Type} (e : RSFError) (f : α → RSFResult β) : RSFResult.bind (Except.error e) f = Except.error e := rfl

theorem RSFResult.map_ok {α β : Type} (v : α) (f : α → β) : RSFResult.map f (Except.ok v) = Except.ok (f v) := rfl

theorem RSFResult.map_error {α β : Type} (e : RSFError) (f : α → β) : RSFResult.map f (Except.error e) = Except.error e := rfl

def Bool.and_true_eq (b : Bool) : b && true = b :=
  match b with
  | true => rfl
  | false => rfl

def maxUsize : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def maxU64 : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def listLength {α : Type} : List α → Nat
| [] => 0
| _ :: as => 1 + listLength as

structure U32 where
  b0 : Nat
  b1 : Nat
  b2 : Nat
  b3 : Nat

structure U64 where
  b0 : Nat
  b1 : Nat
  b2 : Nat
  b3 : Nat
  b4 : Nat
  b5 : Nat
  b6 : Nat
  b7 : Nat

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat

def Shape.is2D (s : Shape) : Bool :=
  match s.dims with
  | _ :: _ :: [] => true
  | _ => false

structure Tensor (N : Type) where
  shape : Shape
  data : List N
  storage_id : Nat
  offset : Nat

def tensorsOverlap {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq a.storage_id b.storage_id with
  | isFalse _ => false
  | isTrue _ =>
    let a_end := a.offset + a.data.length
    let b_end := b.offset + b.data.length
    match Nat.decLt a.offset b_end with
    | isFalse _ => false
    | isTrue _ =>
      match Nat.decLt b.offset a_end with
      | isFalse _ => false
      | isTrue _ => true

def sameTensorStorage {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq a.storage_id b.storage_id with
  | isTrue _ => true
  | isFalse _ => false

def checkedMul (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxUsize with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok (a * b)
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

theorem checkedMul_success (a b : Nat) (h : a * b ≤ maxUsize) : checkedMul a b = Except.ok (a * b) :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxUsize with
  | isTrue _ => rfl
  | isFalse hf => False.elim (hf h)

theorem checkedMul_fail (a b : Nat) (h : ¬ (a * b ≤ maxUsize)) : checkedMul a b = Except.error RSFError.Overflow :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxUsize with
  | isTrue ht => False.elim (h ht)
  | isFalse _ => rfl

def checkedMulU64 (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe (a * b) maxU64 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok (a * b)
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

def checkedAddU64 (a b : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe (a + b) maxU64 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok (a + b)
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.Overflow

def checkedCastU64ToUsize (v : Nat) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decLe v maxUsize with
  | isTrue _ => Except.ok v
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.TooLarge

structure NumericSemantics (N : Type) where
  zero : N
  one : N
  add : N → N → N
  sub : N → N → N
  mul : N → N → N
  div : N → N → N
  exp : N → N
  clip : N → N → N → N
  finite : N → Bool
  f16_convertible : N → Bool
  tol_cmp : N → N → N → N → Bool
  deriv_gate : N → N → N → N
  eq : N → N → Bool
  lt : N → N → Bool
  add_sub_cancel : ∀ a b, sub (add a b) b = a
  sub_add_cancel : ∀ a b, add (sub a b) b = a
  mul_div_cancel : ∀ a b, div (mul a b) b = a
  div_mul_cancel : ∀ a b, mul (div a b) b = a
  clip_min : ∀ v cmin cmax, (finite v → finite cmin → finite cmax → lt cmin cmax → finite (clip v cmin cmax))
  clip_correct : ∀ v cmin cmax, (finite v → finite cmin → finite cmax → lt cmin cmax →
    (lt v cmin → clip v cmin cmax = cmin) ∧
    (lt cmax v → clip v cmin cmax = cmax) ∧
    ((¬ lt v cmin) → (¬ lt cmax v) → clip v cmin cmax = v))
  exp_pos : ∀ v, finite v → finite (exp v) ∧ ¬ eq (exp v) zero
  deriv_gate_spec : ∀ p cmin cmax, (finite p → finite cmin → finite cmax → lt cmin cmax →
    (lt p cmin → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) zero) ∧
    (lt cmax p → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) zero) ∧
    ((¬ lt p cmin) → (¬ lt cmax p) → eq (deriv_gate p cmin cmax) one))

def validateClipRange {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match sem.finite cmin, sem.finite cmax with
  | true, true =>
    match sem.lt cmin cmax with
    | true => Except.ok ()
    | false => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite

def validateComparisonTolerances {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (abs_tol rel_tol : N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match sem.finite abs_tol, sem.finite rel_tol with
  | true, true => Except.ok ()
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidTolerance

def validateTensor2D {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match checkedMul d0 d1 with
    | Except.ok expected =>
      match Nat.decEq t.data.length expected with
      | isTrue _ => Except.ok ()
      | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

def validateTensor2DShape {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (rows cols : Nat) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.decEq d0 rows, Nat.decEq d1 cols with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ =>
      match checkedMul rows cols with
      | Except.ok expected =>
        match Nat.decEq t.data.length expected with
        | isTrue _ => Except.ok ()
        | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch
  | _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

def tensorHasShape {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (rows cols : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | d0 :: d1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.decEq d0 rows, Nat.decEq d1 cols with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ => true
    | _, _ => false
  | _ => false

def tensorsSameShape {N : Type} (a b : Tensor N) : Bool :=
  match a.shape.dims, b.shape.dims with
  | a0 :: a1 :: [], b0 :: b1 :: [] =>
    match Nat.decEq a0 b0, Nat.decEq a1 b1 with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ => true
    | _, _ => false
  | _, _ => false

def ensureFiniteSlice {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → RSFResult Unit
| [] => Except.ok ()
| x :: xs =>
  match sem.finite x with
  | true => ensureFiniteSlice sem xs
  | false => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite

structure RSFConfig (N : Type) where
  clip_min : N
  clip_max : N
  grad_mean : Bool
  max_dim : Nat
  max_layers : Nat

def validateModelConfigValues {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim num_layers : Nat) (cfg : RSFConfig N) : RSFResult Unit :=
  match Nat.decEq dim 0 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  | isFalse _ =>
    match Nat.decEq num_layers 0 with
    | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
    | isFalse _ =>
      match validateClipRange sem cfg.clip_min cfg.clip_max with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok _ =>
        match Nat.decEq cfg.max_dim 0 with
        | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
        | isFalse _ =>
          match Nat.decEq cfg.max_layers 0 with
          | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
          | isFalse _ =>
            match Nat.decLe dim cfg.max_dim with
            | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
            | isTrue _ =>
              match Nat.decLe num_layers cfg.max_layers with
              | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidConfig
              | isTrue _ => Except.ok ()

def validateF16Convertible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → RSFResult Unit
| [] => Except.ok ()
| x :: xs =>
  match sem.finite x, sem.f16_convertible x with
  | true, true => validateF16Convertible sem xs
  | false, _ => Except.error RSFError.NonFinite
  | _, false => Except.error RSFError.NumericFailure

def zeroTensor {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (t : Tensor N) : Tensor N :=
  { t with data := t.data.map (fun _ => sem.zero) }

def tensorClone {N : Type} (t : Tensor N) (new_id : Nat) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D t with
  | Except.ok _ => Except.ok { t with storage_id := new_id, offset := 0 }
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def copyTensorPairInto {N : Type} (in1 in2 out1 out2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsSameShape in1 out1, tensorsSameShape in2 out2 with
  | true, true =>
    match Nat.decEq in1.data.length out1.data.length, Nat.decEq in2.data.length out2.data.length with
    | isTrue _, isTrue _ =>
      match tensorsOverlap out1 out2 with
      | false => Except.ok ({ out1 with data := in1.data }, { out2 with data := in2.data })
      | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
    | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.DataLengthMismatch
  | _, _ => Except.error RSFError.ShapeMismatch

structure LayerCore (N : Type) where
  s_weight : Tensor N
  t_weight : Tensor N
  s_bias : Tensor N
  t_bias : Tensor N
  s_weight_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  t_weight_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  s_bias_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  t_bias_grad : Option (Tensor N)
  dim : Nat
  clip_min : N
  clip_max : N
  grad_mean : Bool

def initOwned {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (gmean : Bool) : RSFResult (LayerCore N) :=
  match Nat.decEq dim 0 with
  | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidDimension
  | isFalse _ =>
    match validateClipRange sem cmin cmax with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok _ =>
      match checkedMul dim dim with
      | Except.error e => Except.error e
      | Except.ok _ =>
        Except.ok {
          s_weight := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 1, offset := 0 }
          t_weight := { shape := { dims := [dim, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 2, offset := 0 }
          s_bias := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 3, offset := 0 }
          t_bias := { shape := { dims := [1, dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 4, offset := 0 }
          s_weight_grad := none
          t_weight_grad := none
          s_bias_grad := none
          t_bias_grad := none
          dim := dim
          clip_min := cmin
          clip_max := cmax
          grad_mean := gmean
        }

def deinitOwned {N : Type} (layer : LayerCore N) : LayerCore N :=
  { layer with
    s_weight_grad := none
    t_weight_grad := none
    s_bias_grad := none
    t_bias_grad := none }

def ensureGradients {N : Type} (layer : LayerCore N) : LayerCore N :=
  let swg := match layer.s_weight_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [layer.dim, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 5, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  let twg := match layer.t_weight_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [layer.dim, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 6, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  let sbg := match layer.s_bias_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [1, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 7, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  let tbg := match layer.t_bias_grad with | none => some { shape := { dims := [1, layer.dim] }, data := [], storage_id := 8, offset := 0 } | some g => some g
  { layer with s_weight_grad := swg, t_weight_grad := twg, s_bias_grad := sbg, t_bias_grad := tbg }

def zeroGradients {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) : LayerCore N :=
  let swg := match layer.s_weight_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  let twg := match layer.t_weight_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  let sbg := match layer.s_bias_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  let tbg := match layer.t_bias_grad with | none => none | some g => some (zeroTensor sem g)
  { layer with s_weight_grad := swg, t_weight_grad := twg, s_bias_grad := sbg, t_bias_grad := tbg }

def elementwiseAdd {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.add a b :: elementwiseAdd sem as bs

def elementwiseSub {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.sub a b :: elementwiseSub sem as bs

def elementwiseMul {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.mul a b :: elementwiseMul sem as bs

def elementwiseDiv {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → List N
| [], _ => []
| _, [] => []
| a::as, b::bs => sem.div a b :: elementwiseDiv sem as bs

def dotProduct {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : List N → List N → N
| [], _ => sem.zero
| _, [] => sem.zero
| a::as, b::bs => sem.add (sem.mul a b) (dotProduct sem as bs)

def computeTranslationRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (tw tb input_row : List N) : List N :=
  List.zipWith (fun w b => sem.add (dotProduct sem w input_row) b) tw tb

def computeScaleRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw sb input_row : List N) : List N :=
  let preact := List.zipWith (fun w b => sem.add (dotProduct sem w input_row) b) sw sb
  let clipped := preact.map (fun v => sem.clip v cmin cmax)
  clipped.map sem.exp

def forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N) : List N × List N :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  (y1, y2)

def inverseRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb y1 y2 : List N) : List N × List N :=
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let x2 := elementwiseSub sem y2 trans
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let x1 := elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale
  (x1, x2)

theorem elementwiseSub_add_cancel {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : ∀ (a b : List N), a.length = b.length → elementwiseSub sem (elementwiseAdd sem a b) b = a
| [], [], _ => rfl
| a::as, b::bs, h =>
  let h_len : as.length = bs.length := Nat.succ.inj h
  congr (congrArg List.cons (sem.sub_add_cancel a b)) (elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem as bs h_len)
| [], b::bs, h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)
| a::as, [], h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)

theorem elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) : ∀ (a b : List N), a.length = b.length → elementwiseDiv sem (elementwiseMul sem a b) b = a
| [], [], _ => rfl
| a::as, b::bs, h =>
  let h_len : as.length = bs.length := Nat.succ.inj h
  congr (congrArg List.cons (sem.div_mul_cancel a b)) (elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel sem as bs h_len)
| [], b::bs, h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)
| a::as, [], h => False.elim (Nat.noConfusion h)

theorem pair_eq {α β : Type} {a c : α} {b d : β} (h1 : a = c) (h2 : b = d) : (a, b) = (c, d) :=
  congr (congrArg Prod.mk h1) h2

theorem inverseRow_forwardRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb x1 x2 : List N)
  (h_len1 : x1.length = (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2).length)
  (h_len2 : x2.length = (computeTranslationRow sem tw tb (elementwiseMul sem x1 (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2))).length) :
  inverseRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb (forwardRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).1 (forwardRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1 x2).2 = (x1, x2) :=
  let scale := computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb x2
  let y1 := elementwiseMul sem x1 scale
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let y2 := elementwiseAdd sem x2 trans
  let h_x2 : elementwiseSub sem y2 trans = x2 := elementwiseSub_add_cancel sem x2 trans h_len2
  let h_scale : computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans) = scale := congrArg (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb) h_x2
  let h_x1 : elementwiseDiv sem y1 (computeScaleRow sem cmin cmax sw sb (elementwiseSub sem y2 trans)) = x1 :=
    Eq.trans (congrArg (elementwiseDiv sem y1) h_scale) (elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel sem x1 scale h_len1)
  pair_eq h_x1 h_x2

def splitInto {N : Type} : Nat → List N → List N × List N
| 0, xs => ([], xs)
| Nat.succ n, [] => ([], [])
| Nat.succ n, x::xs =>
  let (l1, l2) := splitInto n xs
  (x::l1, l2)

def mergeFrom {N : Type} : List N → List N → List N
| [], ys => ys
| x::xs, ys => x :: mergeFrom xs ys

theorem merge_split_roundtrip {N : Type} : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : List N), mergeFrom (splitInto n x).1 (splitInto n x).2 = x
| 0, xs => rfl
| Nat.succ n, [] => rfl
| Nat.succ n, x::xs => congrArg (List.cons x) (merge_split_roundtrip n xs)

def processBatchForward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) : List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [] => ([], [])
| x1, x2 =>
  let (x1_row, x1_rest) := splitInto dim x1
  let (x2_row, x2_rest) := splitInto dim x2
  let (y1_row, y2_row) := forwardRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1_row x2_row
  let (y1_rest, y2_rest) := processBatchForward sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb x1_rest x2_rest
  (mergeFrom y1_row y1_rest, mergeFrom y2_row y2_rest)

def processBatchInverse {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) : List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [] => ([], [])
| y1, y2 =>
  let (y1_row, y1_rest) := splitInto dim y1
  let (y2_row, y2_rest) := splitInto dim y2
  let (x1_row, x2_row) := inverseRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_row y2_row
  let (x1_rest, x2_rest) := processBatchInverse sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_rest y2_rest
  (mergeFrom x1_row x1_rest, mergeFrom x2_row x2_rest)

def forwardInPlace {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (x1 x2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsOverlap x1 x2 with
  | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
  | false =>
    let (y1_data, y2_data) := processBatchForward sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data x1.data x2.data
    Except.ok ({ x1 with data := y1_data }, { x2 with data := y2_data })

def inverseInPlace {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match tensorsOverlap y1 y2 with
  | true => Except.error RSFError.AliasedBuffers
  | false =>
    let (x1_data, x2_data) := processBatchInverse sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data y1.data y2.data
    Except.ok ({ y1 with data := x1_data }, { y2 with data := x2_data })

def forwardChecked {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (x1 x2 out1 out2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match copyTensorPairInto x1 x2 out1 out2 with
  | Except.ok (o1, o2) => forwardInPlace sem layer o1 o2
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def inverseChecked {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 out1 out2 : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  match copyTensorPairInto y1 y2 out1 out2 with
  | Except.ok (o1, o2) => inverseInPlace sem layer o1 o2
  | Except.error e => Except.error e

def computeDsRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) : List N → List N → List N → List N
| [], _, _ => []
| _, [], _ => []
| _, _, [] => []
| p::ps, d::ds, y::ys => sem.mul (sem.deriv_gate p cmin cmax) (sem.mul d y) :: computeDsRow sem cmin cmax ps ds ys

def backwardFromOutputsRow {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : List N) (grad_scale : N) : List N × List N × List N × List N :=
  let dy1_total := elementwiseAdd sem dy1 (computeTranslationRow sem tw tb dy2)
  let trans := computeTranslationRow sem tw tb y1
  let x2_out := elementwiseSub sem y2 trans
  let preact := elementwiseAdd sem sb x2_out
  let clipped := preact.map (fun v => sem.clip v cmin cmax)
  let scale := clipped.map sem.exp
  let x1_out := elementwiseDiv sem y1 scale
  let dx1_out := elementwiseMul sem dy1_total scale
  let ds := computeDsRow sem cmin cmax preact dy1_total y1
  let dx2_out := elementwiseAdd sem dy2 (computeTranslationRow sem sw sb ds)
  (dx1_out, dx2_out, ds, dy1_total)

def processBatchBackward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) (sw tw sb tb : List N) (grad_scale : N) : List N → List N → List N → List N → List N × List N
| [], [], [], [] => ([], [])
| y1, y2, dy1, dy2 =>
  let (y1_row, y1_rest) := splitInto dim y1
  let (y2_row, y2_rest) := splitInto dim y2
  let (dy1_row, dy1_rest) := splitInto dim dy1
  let (dy2_row, dy2_rest) := splitInto dim dy2
  let (dx1_row, dx2_row, _, _) := backwardFromOutputsRow sem cmin cmax sw tw sb tb y1_row y2_row dy1_row dy2_row grad_scale
  let (dx1_rest, dx2_rest) := processBatchBackward sem dim cmin cmax sw tw sb tb grad_scale y1_rest y2_rest dy1_rest dy2_rest
  (mergeFrom dx1_row dx1_rest, mergeFrom dx2_row dx2_rest)

def backwardFromOutputs {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (y1 y2 dy1 dy2 : Tensor N) (grad_scale : N) : RSFResult (Tensor N × Tensor N) :=
  let (dx1_data, dx2_data) := processBatchBackward sem layer.dim layer.clip_min layer.clip_max layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data grad_scale y1.data y2.data dy1.data dy2.data
  Except.ok ({ y1 with data := dx1_data }, { y2 with data := dx2_data })

structure RegistryEntry (Core : Type) where
  core : Core
  active_ops : Nat
  destroyed : Bool

structure Registry (Core : Type) where
  entries : List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core)
  next_id : Nat

def registerRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (core : Core) : Registry Core × Nat :=
  let id := reg.next_id
  let new_entry := { core := core, active_ops := 0, destroyed := false : RegistryEntry Core }
  ({ entries := (id, new_entry) :: reg.entries, next_id := id + 1 }, id)

def lookupEntry {Core : Type} : Nat → List (Nat × RegistryEntry Core) → Option (RegistryEntry Core)
| _, [] => none
| k, (k', v) :: rest =>
  match Nat.decEq k k' with
  | isTrue _ => some v
  | isFalse _ => lookupEntry k rest

def acquireRegistryCore {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) : RSFResult Core :=
  match id with
  | 0 => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    match lookupEntry id reg.entries with
    | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
    | some entry =>
      match entry.destroyed with
      | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized
      | false => Except.ok entry.core

theorem acquire_zero_fails {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) : acquireRegistryCore reg 0 = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized := rfl

theorem acquire_destroyed_fails {Core : Type} (reg : Registry Core) (id : Nat) (entry : RegistryEntry Core)
  (h_id : id ≠ 0) (h_lookup : lookupEntry id reg.entries = some entry) (h_dest : entry.destroyed = true) :
  acquireRegistryCore reg id = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized :=
  match id with
  | 0 => False.elim (h_id rfl)
  | Nat.succ _ =>
    Eq.subst (motive := fun x => (match x with | none => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | some e => match e.destroyed with | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | false => Except.ok e.core) = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized) h_lookup (
      Eq.subst (motive := fun x => (match x with | true => Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized | false => Except.ok entry.core) = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized) h_dest rfl
    )

structure RSFCore (N : Type) where
  dim : Nat
  num_layers : Nat
  layers : List (LayerCore N)
  cfg : RSFConfig N
  gpu_available : Bool
  gpu_weight_version : Nat
  cpu_weight_version : Nat

def checkedModelLayerCount {N : Type} (core : RSFCore N) : RSFResult Nat :=
  match Nat.decEq core.num_layers core.layers.length with
  | isFalse _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidModelState
  | isTrue _ =>
    match Nat.decEq core.layers.length 0 with
    | isTrue _ => Except.error RSFError.InvalidLayerCount
    | isFalse _ => Except.ok core.layers.length

def applyLayersForward {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) : List (LayerCore N) → List N → List N
| [], x => x
| layer :: rest, x =>
  let (x1, x2) := splitInto dim x
  let (y1, y2) := forwardRow sem cmin cmax layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data x1 x2
  let y := mergeFrom y1 y2
  applyLayersForward sem dim cmin cmax rest y

def applyLayersInverse {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (dim : Nat) (cmin cmax : N) : List (LayerCore N) → List N → List N
| [], y => y
| layer :: rest, y =>
  let y_prev := applyLayersInverse sem dim cmin cmax rest y
  let (y1, y2) := splitInto dim y_prev
  let (x1, x2) := inverseRow sem cmin cmax layer.s_weight.data layer.t_weight.data layer.s_bias.data layer.t_bias.data y1 y2
  mergeFrom x1 x2

def forwardOnCore {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D x with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok dim2 =>
      let y_data := applyLayersForward sem core.dim core.cfg.clip_min core.cfg.clip_max core.layers x.data
      Except.ok { x with data := y_data }

def inverseOnCore {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (y : Tensor N) : RSFResult (Tensor N) :=
  match validateTensor2D y with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
    | Except.ok dim2 =>
      let x_data := applyLayersInverse sem core.dim core.cfg.clip_min core.cfg.clip_max core.layers y.data
      Except.ok { y with data := x_data }

theorem forwardOnCore_preserves_shape {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) :
  match forwardOnCore sem core x with
  | Except.ok y => y.shape = x.shape
  | Except.error _ => True :=
  match h_val : validateTensor2D x with
  | Except.error _ => trivial
  | Except.ok _ =>
    match h_mul : checkedMul core.dim 2 with
    | Except.error _ => trivial
    | Except.ok _ => rfl

def layerGPUCompatible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (layer : LayerCore N) (cfg : RSFConfig N) (dim : Nat) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq layer.dim dim with
  | isFalse _ => false
  | isTrue _ =>
    match sem.eq layer.clip_min cfg.clip_min with
    | false => false
    | true =>
      match sem.eq layer.clip_max cfg.clip_max with
      | false => false
      | true =>
        match layer.grad_mean == cfg.grad_mean with
        | false => false
        | true => true

  (h : layer.dim ≠ dim) : layerGPUCompatible sem layer cfg dim = false :=
  match Nat.decEq layer.dim dim with
  | isFalse _ => rfl
  | isTrue heq => False.elim (h heq)

def modelGPUCompatible {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) : Bool :=
  match Nat.decEq core.layers.length 0 with
  | isTrue _ => false
  | isFalse _ => true

def tryForwardGPU {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) : Bool × Tensor N :=
  match core.gpu_available with
  | false => (false, x)
  | true =>
    match modelGPUCompatible sem core with
    | false => (false, x)
    | true =>
      match forwardOnCore sem core x with
      | Except.ok y => (true, y)
      | Except.error _ => (false, x)

theorem gpu_fallback_equals_cpu {N : Type} (sem : NumericSemantics N) (core : RSFCore N) (x : Tensor N) :
  match tryForwardGPU sem core x with
  | (true, y) => forwardOnCore sem core x = Except.ok y
  | (false, _) => True :=
  match core.gpu_available with
  | false => trivial
  | true =>
    match modelGPUCompatible sem core with
    | false => trivial
    | true =>
      match h : forwardOnCore sem core x with
      | Except.ok _ => rfl
      | Except.error _ => trivial

## Verdikt: RÉSZBEN VALÓS, DE KRITIKUS HIÁNYOSSÁGOKKAL

Ez **nem teljes, 100%-os formális Lean 4 verifikáció**. A benyújtott fájl tartalmaz valós term-mode bizonyításokat, de komoly hiányosságai vannak, amelyek miatt nem fogadható el. Részletes analízis következik.

***

## Ami helyes és valós

A fájl több területen genuinisan helyes term-mode bizonyítást tartalmaz:[1]

**Strukturálisan korrekt tételek:** A `checkedMul_success`, `checkedMul_fail`, `RSFResult.bind_ok`, `RSFResult.bind_error`, `RSFResult.map_ok`, `RSFResult.map_error` mind tiszta `rfl`-alapú vagy `False.elim`-alapú bizonyítások, amelyek ténylegesen igazolják a definíciók viselkedését. Ezek valósak.

**Rekurzív strukturális bizonyítások:** Az `elementwiseSub_add_cancel` és `elementwiseDiv_mul_cancel` tételek valódi strukturális indukcióval dolgoznak `Nat.succ.inj`-t és `congr`-t használva, `by` nélkül. Az `inverseRow_forwardRow` tétel valódi kompozicionális érvelés a `forwardRow`/`inverseRow` páron.

**Roundtrip tételek:** `parse_serialize_u32_roundtrip` és `parse_serialize_u64_roundtrip` valós `rfl`-bizonyítások, a `merge_split_roundtrip` rekurzív term-mode bizonyítás.

***

## Kritikus hiányosságok

### 1. rfl mint taktika — TILTOTT

A következő sorok mindegyike sérti a szabályokat:

```
theorem RSFResult.bind_ok ... := rfl
theorem RSFResult.bind_error ... := rfl
theorem RSFResult.map_ok ... := rfl
```

`rfl` önmagában itt term-ként szerepel — ez **elfogadható**, mert `Eq.refl _` rövidítése. **DE**: a szabályrendszer `rfl`-t táktikai kontextusban tilt (`by rfl`), míg standalone term-ként (`... := rfl`) az engedélyezett lista szerint megengedett. Ez a rész tehát **átmegy**.

### 2. `acquire_destroyed_fails` — HELYTELENÜL KONSTRUÁLT BIZONYÍTÁS

Ez a bizonyítás nem helyes Lean 4 term-mode szemantikával:

```lean
Eq.subst (motive := fun x => ...) h_lookup (
  Eq.subst (motive := fun x => ...) h_dest rfl
)
```

Az `Eq.subst` itt nem jól van alkalmazva: az `h_lookup : lookupEntry id reg.entries = some entry` nem közvetlenül szubsztituálható be a kifejezés fába ilyen módon, mert a match-elágazás típusa `Except RSFError ...`, nem `_ = Except.error RSFError.NotInitialized`. Ez a bizonyítás **nem fog lefordulni valódi Lean 4 kernelen**.[1]

### 3. `forwardOnCore_preserves_shape` — TRIVIÁLIS PLACEHOLDER

```lean
| Except.ok _ => rfl
```

Ez a sor azt állítja, hogy `y.shape = x.shape`, ahol `y` az `applyLayersForward` eredménye. De az `applyLayersForward` definíciójában az output adatstruktúrát `{ x with data := y_data }` alakban adja vissza, vagyis a shape valóban megőrződik — de ezt a Lean kernelnek is be kell látnia redukcióval. A `rfl` csak akkor érvényes, ha a kifejezés **definitionally equal** mindkét oldalon. Ez esetben **lehet, hogy lefordul**, de **csak véletlenszerűen helyes**: ha az `applyLayersForward` mélyen rekurzív és nem redukálódik le normálformára a kernel előtt, ez `rfl`-lel nem igazolható. Hiányzik a tényleges szerkezeti induktív bizonyítás a layers listán.[1]

### 4. `gpu_fallback_equals_cpu` — `trivial` TILTOTT

```lean
| false => trivial
| true  => trivial
```

A `trivial` taktika! Ez egyenértékű `by trivial`-lal. A `trivial` a Lean taktika könyvtárban van definiálva, és `by` blokkon kívül önálló termként **nem létezik** a standard Lean 4-ben — ez pszeudo-term, ami csak taktika módban él. **TILTOTT**.[1]

### 5. 1:10 arány — NEM TELJESÜL

A Zig forrás ~1200 sor érdemi kód. A benyújtott Lean fájl körülbelül ~600-700 sor bizonyítást tartalmaz, ami ~0.5:1 arány. A **minimálisan elvárt** 1:10 arány ~12 000 sor bizonyítást igényelne. Az alábbi Zig funkciók teljesen **verifikálatlanok**:

- `tensorsOverlap` — nincs tétel arról, hogy két különböző `storage_id`-jű tensor nem fedhet át
- `copyTensorPairInto` — nincs bizonyítás a helyes másolási feltételekre
- `processBatchForward`/`processBatchInverse` — nincs `processBatchInverse_processBatchForward` roundtrip tétel
- `backwardFromOutputs` — nincs formális specifikáció a gradiens helységéről
